source: No manual parse yet. What is known is from play and from docs/experiments.md (START pulses pass character select). A real prior needs the boxed documentation — see docs/manuals.md and docs/zero_shot_protocol.md. Until then every fact here is either observed on screen or left out.
notes: START pulses get through character select (docs/experiments.md).
Battletoads is hard for humans: the pipeline is being exercised on it deliberately.

facts.statement: Press START to begin play and to pass character select.

citation.figure: observed on screen during explore runs; not yet traced to a manual page

facts.statement: The HUD shows a 6-segment energy BAR and five HEARTS together (top-left under the score). Layout and palette drift across levels: level 1 draws white hearts and a blue bar to the right of the score; other screens stack gold hearts under a gold bar.

citation.figure: runs/knowledge/bt_video/f_00880.png (level 1) + owner photo 2026-10-10; both cited in runs/knowledge/hud_by_level/survey.json

facts.statement: The bar has 6 segments. On the owner's screenshot two hits left 4 filled and 2 empty slots still drawn.

citation.figure: owner correction 2026-10-10: 'bar is 6 segments, two hits, two unfilled'

facts.statement: On level 1 a hit emptied one heart (3 filled -> 2) while the bar stayed 6/6. Hearts and bar are not the same meter, or they drop on different damage; do not assume one implies the other.

Damage granularity is half-unit (half a heart / half a bar segment) per the owner. Live half-heart steps are not yet measured on NES frames; heart fill density drops in discrete blobs (0.84 full / 0.26 empty on level 1).

citation.figure: owner observation 2026-10-08, corrected 2026-10-10; not yet traced to a manual page

facts.statement: Levels change the gameplay itself — about ten kinds across the game (vehicle, platformer, underwater, etc.). A policy or prior that works on one level type may be inert on the next. Scope every fact by level type, the way Contra's manual scopes by scroll mode.

citation.figure: owner observation 2026-10-15: 'levels change the gameplay, about ten kinds across the game'

facts.statement: HUD layout and palette drift across levels: level 1 draws white hearts and a blue bar to the right of the score; other screens stack gold hearts under a gold bar. Do not hard-code one geometry.
